tools.name: project_get
tools.description: Read canonical source, configuration, current revision, repository, and releases. Never includes credentials or private memory.

tools.name: project_edit
tools.description: Change ordinary frontend source files using an optimistic revision. A file value of null deletes it. sure.json contains scheduling and theme configuration.

tools.name: project_configure
tools.description: Patch scheduling rules, theme, copy, or questions in the canonical sure.json source. Values are validated before saving.

tools.name: project_pull
tools.description: Restore the draft from this project’s Sidekin-hosted Git main branch. Rejects uncommitted draft edits unless discardLocalChanges is explicitly authorized; previous revisions are retained.

tools.name: project_commit
tools.description: Commit the current source to this project’s Sidekin-hosted Git remote. Git pushes and MCP edits share this source and revision checks prevent overwriting concurrent work.

tools.name: project_preview
tools.description: Create a short-lived preview URL for the exact current source revision. No public release changes.

tools.name: project_publish
tools.description: Publish the exact current, committed source revision to the project public URL.

tools.name: project_rollback
tools.description: Restore a previously published frontend/configuration release. This never changes or cancels bookings.
